title: Python fixed-profile SCHC sender accepts non-profile tile and window geometry
description: The public fixed-profile FragmentSender accepts any positive tile_size and any window_size from 1 through 63, then schedules fragments using those values. Fragment.to_bytes nevertheless requires every regular tile to be exactly 187 bytes and the ACK codec is fixed to a 63-position bitmap. Accepted configurations such as tile_size=1 or 188 can therefore build fragment objects that cannot serialize or interoperate. Existing scheduling tests use tile_size=1/window_size=4 but never serialize the result, hiding the inconsistency.
acceptance_criteria: The production FragmentSender accepts only the normative TILE_SIZE=187 and WINDOW_SIZE=63, or variable geometry is moved behind a private test-only scheduler paired with codecs that explicitly support it. Every configuration accepted by the public sender must allow every generated fragment and ACK to serialize, parse, and round-trip. Replace synthetic geometry tests with fixed-profile boundary/schedule tests or a clearly isolated scheduler unit test. Add rejection tests for tile sizes 0, 1, 186, 188 and window sizes 0, 1, 62, 64 as appropriate to the chosen API.
